limitations: Course-reference counts differ from distinct contribution URLs and from authors. A multi-course post is one contribution; anonymous cross-thread identity cannot be verified.

The 2026-09-25 expansion adds three Xiaohongshu notes, one Dcard reply and one original student blog. Xiaohongshu search discovery is limited; some public share URLs return login or unavailable pages.
Eight star-rated course references now all come from one Xiaohongshu author. No star maximum is asserted; text and self-reported letter grades are never transformed into numerical ratings.
No source date or academic term is inferred from crawling or verification dates. Source edit dates are labelled in context.
2026-09-25 bounded searches of LIHKG and Reddit did not yield a publishable code-matched course review. Readable Reddit experiences concern unnamed courses or programmes and are excluded.
The five Korean blog references share one author and one post. Only the explicitly located course experiences are summarised; other personal narrative and images are not stored.
The 2026-09-16 baseline is retained with its original verification dates; this expansion is not a fresh re-verification of every historical reference.
Candidate or excluded items remain unpublished. The research does not claim to exhaust all departments, platforms, comments, images or video.
